diagnosis.summary: The nightly run a74ad996 for 2026-10-01 failed in the transform step because someone changed dim_customers so it reads c.country_iso. That column doesn't exist: stg_customers and the customers file upstream sent still use `country`. I've proposed reverting dim_customers to the deployed version. It hasn't been applied or rerun yet; the harness will apply it, rerun the pipeline and check the result.

root_cause.explanation: The running dim_customers.sql differs from the deployed version: c.country was replaced with c.country_iso. stg_customers has no column with that name, so the build stopped with a Binder Error. Ingest succeeded, and the 2026-10-01 customers file matches the contract (its header has `country`), so the incoming data is not the cause.

evidence.claim: The transform step failed. Ingest succeeded.
dim_customers errored because it references column country_iso, which doesn't exist
dim_customers is the only changed model, and its diff replaces country with country_iso
The customers file upstream sent matches the contract and still uses the column name `country`
The runbook says to revert the model that changed

alternatives_considered: Upstream renamed the column (country to country_iso): ruled out, because the file still has `country` and nothing is missing from the contract
A staging model change caused the error: ruled out, because dim_customers is the only changed model
The change was a deliberate business-logic change, which would mean escalating to analytics_engineering: unlikely, because it references a column that doesn't exist anywhere upstream
A one-off failure that a plain rerun would fix: ruled out, because the Binder Error comes from the code and would happen again on every run

proposal.rationale: dim_customers is the only changed model; its diff swaps c.country for c.country_iso, a column stg_customers/landing data do not have (landing header still has 'country', ingest succeeded). Reverting restores the deployed, working SQL.

applied: reverted models/marts/dim_customers.sql to the deployed version
